description: This file defines locale-specific culture information and date parsing/formatting functions for Kiswahili (Kenya) within the DateJS library. It includes culture constants, date format patterns, regex patterns for parsing date components, and extensions to the Date prototype for date calculations and manipulations.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets time components of a Date object to zero, effectively setting the time to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of a Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of a Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the Date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks whether two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week from its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month from its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specified month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name corresponding to a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset associated with a timezone name.
